stageEffects.source: Hachiman battle intel Special Effect tooltips, Diff. Bonus 8 visible
stageEffects.continuousDamage: Allies' continuous damage is increased by 30%.
stageEffects.curseDamage: Party's Curse damage is increased by 20%.
stageEffects.criticalConversion: When allies deal damage with skills or Resonances, standard critical damage calculations are not carried out (regardless of whether or not a critical hit occurs), but deal increased final damage from skills and Resonances. This increase is equal to critical hit rate x (critical damage - 100%). (Max critical hit rate in this calculation is 100%).
stageEffects.fourthEffect: A fourth (red) Special Effect tab was visible but not opened; presumed to be the Guardian/Medic composition effect read on 2026-09-05.
stageEffects.modelNote: The conversion is described as increased final damage. The engine multiplies it with the other final-damage effects (+20% composition, Summertime Refresh, Concert +10%); whether final-damage increases add or multiply is unverified.

inBattlePanelsAfterT1.note: Character Details opened in battle after T1. Values include the navigator share and Revelation set effects; Damage Mult. visibly includes active party buffs and is not used as an equipped input.

confirmations.vorpalButterflyHighHpClause: The +200% skill damage condition is active on the infinite-HP Hachiman.
confirmations.idolDamageScoring: Damage dealt to the Daisoujou idols does not contribute to the score.

jcAwareness2CallousKindness.text: When a Facade is gained, gain the following buff based on the type of Facade: Facade of Mischief & Innocence: Increase party's Attack by 30% for 2 turns. Facade of Service & Admonition: Decrease party's damage taken by 20% for 2 turns. Facade of Absurdity & Nonsense: Increase critical damage of the Assassin or Sweeper ally with the highest Attack by 20% for 2 turns. Facade of Luck & Loss: Increase Justine & Caroline's skill damage by 10% for 2 turns.
jcAwareness2CallousKindness.engineNote: Matches applyJcFacadeAwareness: the Attack buff comes only from the Mischief Facade (S1), so a T1 S1 / T2 Gun opener leaves Berry's T3 S3 without it.
